title: Stop borrowing greatness from the world
summary: Worldly stature cannot save; humble company can lift the heart quickly. Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
takeaway: Let contentment quiet the need to compare.
lifeApplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.

source.shortMeaning: Worldly stature cannot save; humble company can lift the heart quickly.
source.lifeApplication: When status pulls you, choose the company that deepens remembrance instead.

evidence.coreClaim: Worldly stature cannot save; humble company can lift the heart quickly.
evidence.turn: Remember this: seek the humble servant, not the world's impressive names.
evidence.practicalImplication: When envy rises, step away from the screen and return the mind to one truthful task already in your hands today.
